title: Roll, pitch, yaw and angle wrapping
keywords: roll pitch yaw rpy euler angle angles wrap wrapping normalize atan2 gimbal lock heading
text: Roll, pitch and yaw rotate about the fixed X, Y and Z axes in that order (REP 103), which equals rotating about Z, then the new Y, then the new X; tf2's setRPY and getRPY use this convention. Angles are in radians and yaw wraps around: normalize differences to [-pi, pi] (atan2(sin a, cos a), or angles::normalize_angle), otherwise a robot at 179 degrees told to face -179 degrees turns almost a full circle. Near a pitch of +/-90 degrees roll and yaw become ambiguous (gimbal lock), so compute with quaternions and convert to roll, pitch and yaw only for display.
